chapter: Porgy and Bess and Varsity Show
title: Cast of Porgy and Bess
summary: He names Todd Duncan, Ann Wiggins Brown, Joe Attles as his understudy and others.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I have two questions before we go ahead to Nazarro calling you back. One is, who are some of the other people that played in "Porgy and Bess?"
We had Todd Duncan, he was Porgy. And Ann Wiggins Brown

was Bess. Seren Robins was Crown's wife and Maria was just a -- took care like a mother around -- and then we had Mr. Johnson -- what's his first name? Johnson was the lawyer. And we had Joe Attles who was the understudy for Sportin' Life and -- I can't think of all -- Elton Warren was the sweetheart of somebody, I forgot who that was.
